programme.title: Meet The Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Marsupials were once found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch. Whether hopping, climbing or even airborne, marsupials are some of the strangest but most fascinating creatures you're likely to meet.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: A mesmerizing journey on the border of two amazing worlds - beyond the turquoise waters of Raja Ampat, a paradise of diverse coral gardens, multitudes of fascinating species of fish and towering barrel sponges and up on the land where the unique cultures and ways of life, as well as struggles and triumphs of the people who call this remote and stunning corner of the world home are shown.

programme.title: Wild Waters
programme.desc: From the highest mountain to the lowest valley, rivers and streams are freshwater highways, de-livering essential life blood to all kinds of wildlife. From some of the most iconic species like the otter and the trout, to the unfamiliar and elusive, like the delicate harvest mouse. Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. Take a break from the oceans and turn to the rivers and streams, home to the real wild waters of the nat-ural world.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dangerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble. And they're not just stealthy, they're also some of the most enigmatic and beautiful creatures on the planet.

programme.title: Meet The Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Marsupials were once found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch. programme.title: mareTV: In Alaska's Fjord World
programme.desc: Gigantic fjords and over 5,000 small islands: In Alaska's south there's a lot of wilderness and little civilization. The region between the capital Juneau and the Canadian border is also known by locals as the "Last Frontier", the last outpost. Michelle Masden, for example, has come to terms with the harsh conditions here. She is the only seaplane pilot in the region. She earns her living with her 65-year-old Beaver: as an air taxi, transport plane and now and then as a rescuer in last necessity. Michelle flies anything and everything: spare parts and food, doctors, hikers and hunters. For the fishermen of southern Alaska she searches for large shoals of fish and guides the captains to the next good catch. Ray Rusaw was a car mechanic by profession, but in his old age he was gripped by gold fever. With a self-built special raft and a highly creative selection of equipment from the DIY store, he sets off in search of the precious metal that his predecessors overlooked two centuries ago. For four years he has been happily obsessively combing through sandbanks and river courses. For Ray, the search for gold has little to do with luck and much to do with meticulous research. He is certain that he has found the perfect spot.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It's a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It's a country that's astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Amazing Iran
programme.desc: For the Iranian Turkmen a wedding is one of most important social events in their culture and is still celebrated according to old nomadic tradition. The Turkmen Steppe, the country of a thousand mountains, is a tribute to the hidden treasure that is Iran. Home to a proud nation with a majestic history, we show the freedom of a nomadic life, encounter the wild nature of the people and discover old traditions like the Turkmen wedding. Breathtaking sceneries create a mysticism that transports viewers into the realm of divinity while exposing a world caught between tradition and modernity - nomadism and sedentarism. Weddings in Iran are primarily arrangements between families and the product of lengthy negotiations. Even though many customs are purely symbolic, they still reflect the great significance as a rite of transition for the newlyweds and their families. The life of the Turkmen housewife revolves around weddings – first her own, later those of her children. Raising healthy, capable daughters and sons searching for possible partners mediating contact negotiating each betrothal with the family of the intended shouldering the wedding arrangements and the observance of customs and traditions – the responsibility for all of that falls to the mother. Though the Turkmen daughters and sons of today do insist on having their say, love, affection, trust and the like are still not the decisive criteria in making a match. The main consideration is not the subjective happiness of the couple but the happiness, stability and honor of each of their families as a whole. So it is still not uncommon for the bride and groom to be virtual strangers on their wedding day. The nuptials as a ritual of transition mark a series of profound changes – especially in the life of the bride. Once married, she leaves her family and her home village to take her new place within the family of the groom.

programme.title: Berlin from Above
programme.desc: Unique pictures from above. This documentary shows a different angle of people and country, during a glide flight above the metropolis. More than 25 years after the reunion between East and West Germany, this movie shows pictures from different perspectives. Which visions and dreams marked this region? What changed and what emerged in Germany's tensed city. We take a look from above to see the city and its citizens. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to see how the people make this area their home. The movie unites nature, urbanity, tranquility and the rush of a metropolis. It unites parks and skyscraper canyons, lake capes and wetlands, curvy courses of rivers and straight streets. With exhilarating pictures we take a trip through Berlin- from sunrise til sunset. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to get a glimpse at how the people make this area their home.

programme.title: Street of Gongs
programme.desc: In Thailand's rural northeast you will find the street of Gongs. Outside the provincial capital of Ubon Ratchatani in Thailand's rural northeast, a country road nearly thirty kilometers long stretches to the banks of the Mekong River. Even from a distance, you can hear what is being made there: gongs of all sizes in nearly 50 manufactories. The gong is considered the ancient instrument and symbol of Asia. It occupies an important cultural significance, initiates rituals, expels demons, gives strength and courage. This film visits the creators of these unique instruments - a family business that has been laboriously handcrafting gongs for generations. They have a big mission: The abbot of the temple has ordered a new, large gong for the upcoming festival. Will they be able to finish it in time?

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the R&B quintet FROM ALL TO HUMAN! Composed of vocalist Blesssing guitarist PARK JAE WOO bassist NAM WOO SEOK keyboardist MOON SUNG HWAN and drummer MOON SEONG HO this band brought a new wave of R&B to the Korean music scene upon their debut in 2017. With their band's name referring to a journey “from all beings to humans” the five hope to develop every day as musicians. True to their name they are evolving and developing every day winning the Grand Prize at the 2019 Shinhan Card Rookie Project and the TOP2 at KT&G's SangSang Madang Band Discovery Competition in 2019. From acid jazz to R&B to new jack swing the quintet covers a wide range of genres in their music backed up by solid storylines which makes them truly one of a kind. In this episode FROM ALL TO HUMAN performs Dizzy Oriental chill Don't be disappointed and more to showcase the quintessence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five genuine musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the city pop band ADOY! Composed of vocalist and guitarist Oh Juhwan keyboardist Zee bassist Jung Dayoung and drummer Park Geunchang this quartet burst onto the music scene in 2017 with the EP CATNIP. Thanks to the success of Grace and San Francisco from the EP they topped the K-Indie Chart and became nominated for Best Modern Rock at the prestigious Korean Music Awards in 2018. Then in the following year they won Judges' Prize at the Seoul Music Awards creating a new flow of Korean city pop. ADOY's music has a special power. Iit fills the city with romantic vibes instantly and also transforms city noises into sophisticated tunes. What's more their music has mass appeal yet it is unique. So now the quartet itself is a genre that mesmerizes not only Korean listeners but also the world. Last month ADOY released their new EP her to display their ever-evolving artistry and the quartet is here to perform their latest tracks including Simply Antihero Baby and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet ADOY!

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Dimmi che fai tutto per me
programme.desc: Il dottor Francesco Salmarani si trova all'improvviso con il conto in banca scoperto poiché il padre di sua moglie è giunto dall'America esigendo l'acquisto di una villa. Francesco si lascia irretire dalla giovanissima e bella Mary e il sogno di fuggire con lei induce il dottore a organizzare un colpo ai danni del suocero che è riuscito a trasferire in villa un ingente patrimonio in dollari.

programme.title: La contessa azzurra

programme.title: Le motorizzate
programme.desc: Cinque episodi raccontano con ironia il rapporto tra donne, automobili e vita quotidiana nell'Italia del boom economico. Tra suore spericolate, automobiliste, truffe, equivoci e improbabili vigili urbani, una commedia corale che mette in scena vizi e ossessioni dell'Italia su quattro ruote.

programme.title: Noi Duri
programme.desc: A Parigi un improbabile agente di polizia si trova sulle tracce di una banda di trafficanti di droga. Tra locali notturni, scambi di persona e gag, l'indagine diventa una parodia movimentata del poliziesco.

programme.title: Questa volta parliamo di uomini
programme.desc: Quattro episodi mettono sotto osservazione uomini egoisti, opportunisti e incapaci di comprendere le donne che hanno accanto. Una commedia amara che rovescia ironicamente stereotipi e rapporti di coppia.

programme.title: Le cameriere
programme.desc: Gabriella, cameriera, indossa a una festa un gioiello della padrona e viene accusata quando questo scompare. Le altre domestiche decidono di trovare il vero ladro, dando il via a una movimentata indagine improvvisata.

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: C'era una volta
programme.desc: Napoli, XVII secolo. Il principe Rodrigo Ferrantte y Davalos, nobile spagnolo di grande fascino e coraggio, è in Italia. Deve trovare una sposa e la corte gli impone la scelta tra sette belle principesse. Ma lui s`innamora di una paesana, semplice, fiera e sanguigna, di rara bellezza e di incredibili virtù, di nome Isabella. Il loro amore, fulmineo e improvviso, incontrerà molti ostacoli...

programme.title: L'imperdibile viaggio di Harold Fry
programme.desc: Harold è un uomo qualunque che ha sempre vissuto senza prendere iniziative. Un giorno scopre che una vecchia amica è molto malata e decide di andarla a trovare attraversando a piedi l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: Caccia all'uomo
programme.desc: Francia, 1944: Pierre Brossard - uno dei pochi ufficiali che fa parte della Milizia, un gruppo parapoliziesco controllato dal governo di Vichy - si rende responsabile dell'uccisione di sette membri ebrei della Resistenza. Dopo la liberazione, Brossard va sotto processo ed è condannato per i suoi crimini, ma sfugge alla cattura e anni dopo viene graziato. 1992: la vita di Brossard viene sconvolta da un'aggressione e dal fatto che una nuova legge permetterà di riportare davanti alla giustizia i criminali di guerra che non hanno scontato le loro condanne.

programme.title: Ithaca
programme.desc: Primavera del 1942. Dopo la partenza del fratello per il fronte, Homer Macauley, 14 anni, è determinato a diventare il più veloce portalettere dell'ufficio del telegrafo così da poter mantenere la sua numerosa famiglia. E così, mentre sull'isola di Ithaca la primavera lascia il posto all'estate, il giovane Homer passa le sue giornata a recapitare messaggi d'amore e di speranza ma anche di dolore e morte, finché anche lui non riceverà un messaggio che gli cambierà la vita per sempre

programme.title: The Old Man and The Gun

programme.title: UN NATALE A LUME DI CANDELA

programme.title: UN CASANOVA A NATALE

Mentre i due si affannano per organizzare il Natale più bello di sempre, diventa chiaro che Daniyal potrebbe stare cercando di conquistare la donna sbagliata.

programme.title: L'EREDITIERA DEL NATALE
programme.desc: Loryn, erede di un grande magazzino negli Hamptons, viene messa alla prova dalla nonna nel tentativo di motivarla. Loryn si destreggia tra le attività lavorative nel negozio durante il periodo più intenso dell'anno: il Natale.

programme.title: IO E MR. CHRISTMAS
programme.desc: Zoe Deans, esperta di pubbliche relazioni, lascia la grande agenzia per aprire la propria attività, ma ha bisogno di un cliente importante per farsi notare. Su suggerimento del suo migliore amico Nic, decide di rappresentare un concorrente al concorso natalizio Mr. Christmas, trasformando l'evento in una grande occasione pubblicitaria. Convinta che creare una piccola celebrità natalizia sia facile grazie alla sua esperienza, Zoe si lancia con entusiasmo in questa sfida non convenzionale — decisa a trovare “il ragazzo giusto” da trasformare in star.

programme.title: UN REGALO SPECIALE
programme.desc: Quando le sorelle Cara e Amy stringono un patto per trovare l'anima gemella entro il prossimo Natale, non si aspettano di essere così fortunate. Un anno dopo, il matrimonio di Amy si avvicina e Cara trova la sua anima gemella, ma la perde rapidamente. Il suo desiderio si avvererà?

programme.title: Gli irriducibili
programme.desc: Due fratelli ereditano una fattoria dal padre, ma dopo qualche anno la difficile situazione economica spinge i due ad appiccare un incendio alla proprietà e mettendosi però contro la legge, con la quale lotteranno fino alla fine.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs e Octopus accettano un lavoro dal loro padrone di casa, in cambio di una lauta ricompensa: rapire un bambino. Ben presto, il bebè risveglia forti sentimenti paterni nei due truffatori, portando a complicazioni quando si tratta di riconsegnarlo.

programme.title: Queen of the desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell, personaggio realmente esistito è una donna inglese dalla vita ricca e avventurosa che, all'alba del XX secolo, fu viaggiatrice, scrittrice, archeologa, esploratrice, cartografa, agente segreto e diplomatica per conto dell'Impero Britannico.

programme.title: Lamore non basta
programme.desc: Martina è un'assistente di volo. Durante un volo conosce Angelo, un ragazzo timido e introverso che come lei vive in un piccolo paese dell'Abruzzo. Scopriranno invece di conoscersi da molto tempo.

programme.title: Undisputed 4: Il ritorno di Boyka
programme.desc: accidentale sul ring lo costringe a mettere in discussione tutto ciò che egli rappresenta.Yuri Boyka sta portando in alto il suo nome nel mondo dei grandi campionati di combattimento quando una morte

programme.title: Bleeding Steel: Eroe di acciaio
programme.desc: Un agente delle forze speciali (Jackie Chan) impegnato nelle indagini su un misterioso progetto scientifico viene ferito gravemente nello scontro a fuoco iniziato per salvare l'ideatore dell'azione di una banda di criminali interessata ad impossessarsi della formula per l'immortalità.

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: Violet, sedici anni, sogna di fare la cantante e vive sola con sua madre che ha difficoltà ad arrivare a fine mese. Quando scopre che sono aperte le audizioni per il talent show Teen Spirit, partecipa nella speranza che sia il punto di partenza per la sua carriera di cantante.

programme.title: Labirinti e mostri
programme.desc: Robbie ei suoi compagni di college sono tutti ossessionati dal gioco di ruolo "Labirinti e mostri". Tuttavia, i giochi prendono una strana piega quando Robbie inizia a sperimentare visioni dopo aver giocato una sessione in un mistico punto di riferimento locale.

programme.title: Il silenzio del testimone
programme.desc: Un importante avvocato difensore torna nella sua piccola città natale per difendere un vecchio amico accusato di omicidio.

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

programme.title: Grace is Gone
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo porta le figlie in viaggio prima di dir loro la verità

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Indovina chi
programme.desc: Theresa, una ragazza, porta il suo fidanzato, Simon, a casa per presentarlo ai suoi genitori e annunciare che si sono fidanzati. C'è un'altra sorpresa: Simon è bianco.

programme.title: La ricetta dell'amore
programme.desc: Courtney è un cuoco che gestisce il ristorante di famiglia. Vive le sue storie in base ad un cimelio lasciatoli in eredità dal padre: un libro intitolato "Le Regole dell'Amore". Quando il bel Jake piomba nella sua vita, lei si trova a scoprire l'amore dove se lo sarebbe meno aspettato.

programme.title: Scelta d'amore
programme.desc: Quando una giovane proprietaria di una caffetteria è minacciata di pignoramento, deve rischiare con la vita e l'amore mentre lotta per salvare la sua attività.

programme.title: Ridatemi mia figlia
programme.desc: Dopo la scomparsa della figlia a seguito del successo dell'apertura del suo ristorante, Eve decide di prendere in mano la situazione e scoprire chi c'è dietro al rapimento.

programme.title: Alvin Superstar
programme.desc: Tre scoiattoli musicisti vengono scoperti da un aspirante cantautore e vogliono diventare famosi usando le loro incredibili capacità di canto.

programme.title: Il fiume delle verità
programme.desc: In questa coinvolgente storia d'amore un ventenne ribelle abbandona casa per andare a vivere in solitudine sulle rive di un fiume bellissimo ma selvaggio e quello che trova non è solo se stesso ma anche il vero amore.

programme.title: Conversazioni con altre donne
programme.desc: Nove anni dopo essersi lasciati, due ex anime gemelle si incontrano casualmente durante un ricevimento di nozze a Tropea.

programme.title: Due cuori e una tenda
programme.desc: Durante un'inaspettata vacanza in campeggio organizzata all'ultimo minuto, due perfetti sconosciuti si ritrovano a condividere la stessa tenda per errore. Tra disastri comici, notti sotto le stelle e momenti inaspettatamente teneri, scoprono che forse l'amore si nasconde nei luoghi più improbabili.

programme.title: The Clue to Love
programme.desc: L'ambiziosa Audrey Harper si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere sulla speciale ma anonima rubrica di consigli amorosi Chiedi a zia Hope, un pilastro del giornale locale della città. Incontra così l'affascinante caporedattore Morgan Cooper, che la aiuta a scoprire la vera identità della "zia Hope".

programme.title: Ritorno a Romance
programme.desc: Zoe Davis è una wedding planner di successo e molto determinata che vive in una grande città. Quando il padre le chiede di aiutarlo nel ristorante di famiglia, lei torna volentieri nella sua accogliente città natale di Romance, nell'Oregon.

programme.title: Un padre in prestito
programme.desc: Per poter adottare un ragazzo problematico, un impiegato postale solitario e non sposato deve dimostrare di essere emotivamente qualificato per amare e accudire un bambino.

programme.title: Palma
programme.desc: Russia, anni '70. Il pastore tedesco Palma viene inavvertitamente lasciato in aeroporto dal proprietario. Il cane resta quindi ad aspettare finché viene trovato da un pilota che lo porta a casa dal figlio Nicholas. Comincia così la storia di un'indissolubile amicizia. Ispirato a fatti reali.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: La giornalista di fama mondiale e attivista per i diritti umani Anna Politkovskaya combatte una coraggiosa crociata nella Russia di Putin, lottando per essere una voce indipendente della verità per il popolo.

programme.title: Empire Records
programme.desc: Gli impiegati dell'Empire Records, un negozio di musica che sta per essere venduto ad una grossa compagnia, uniscono le proprie forze per organizzare una festa al fine di raccogliere il denaro sufficiente per comprare l'attività.

programme.title: The Californians
programme.desc: In una versione di 'Le bostoniane' di Henry James, una battaglia infuria tra due fratelli. Gavin, uno scaltro imprenditore, e sua sorella Olive, un'ambientalista risoluta. Ma una straordinaria cantante, Zoe, si interpone tra i due.

programme.title: Una dolce occasione
programme.desc: Dopo aver ereditato The Merry & Bright Candy Cane Kitchen di sua nonna, Kate Bracwell assume lo specialista in recupero aziendale Gabe Sumner per aiutarla a migliorare l'azienda. Ma non è tutto semplice Gabe è un cinico del Natale e Kate trova difficile accettare il cambiamento, ma mentre lavorano insieme e riscoprono la magia del Natale, l'amore sboccia.

programme.title: La ricetta dellamore
programme.desc: Courtney è una chef che gestisce il ristorante di famiglia, armata di un cimelio di famiglia lasciato da suo padre chiamato "Libro delle regole dell'amore" per mostrarle la strada. Alla fine trova l'amore nel posto che meno si aspettava.

programme.title: La lingua dellamore
programme.desc: Dottorato in Linguistica Julie può parlare quasi tutte le lingue. Le cose si capovolgono per Julie quando il bel Dan la contatta per prendere lezioni di francese. Volano presto scintille: potrebbe essere questo il loro abbinamento perfetto?

programme.title: Il disegno del Natale
programme.desc: Ember Morley, graphic designer e aspirante illustratrice di libri di fiabe a Manhattan, rimane sorpresa quando scopre di aver ereditato la fattoria degli alberi di Natale di sua nonna. Ritorna nella sua città natale, Willow Hill, per venderlo prima di Natale, ma gli affascinanti cittadini la convincono a restare un po' più a lungo e ad aiutarla a pianificare il loro annuale Festival dell'albero di Natale. Quando è costretta a lavorare con Brandon Hart, il bel custode della fattoria, Ember si ricorda delle cose che una volta desiderava nella vita. La magia del Natale la guiderà sulla strada giusta?

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: Justine arriva con il neomarito alla festa delle nozze che il cognato e la sorella Claire le hanno organizzato con un ritmato protocollo. Justine sorride molto ma dentro di sé prova un disagio profondo che la spingerà ad allontanarsi in più occasioni dai festeggiamenti provocando lo sconcerto di molti, marito compreso. Non si tratta però solo di un malessere esistenziale privato. Una grave minaccia incombe sulla Terra: il pianeta Melancholia si sta avvicinando e, benché il mondo scientifico inviti all'ottimismo, il rischio di collisione e di distruzione totale del globo terrestre è più che mai realistico.

programme.title: Non ti posso dimenticare
programme.desc: Fred Astaire impersona un eroico pilota della seconda guerra mondiale innamorato di una dattilografa la quale, ignara del suo valore, lo disprezza credendolo un imboscato. Alla fine la donna scoprirà la verità.

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Te
programme.desc: La trentenne Daphe ha appena chiuso una relazione. A una festa incontra due uomini affascinanti e opposti: con entrambi avvia una relazione.

programme.title: Dalle 5 Alle 7
programme.desc: Un aspirante romanziere comincia una relazione con una donna, anche se c'è solo un problema: la donna è sposata e la coppia può incontrarsi solo tra le 5 e le 7 ogni sera.

programme.title: The greatest movie ever sold
programme.desc: Morgan Spurlock rivela il lato nascosto del mondo del marketing attaccando con grande umorismo la pubblicità illegittima nel cinema e in televisione attraverso il cosiddetto product placement.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: Mrs. Mills
programme.desc: Helene possiede un appartamento chic nel centro di Parigi, pubblica romanzi romanticamente kitsch e conduce una vita completamente dettata dal lavoro. Tutto il suo amore è per i libri. Ma la sua vita quotidiana viene stravolta quando la signora Mills, un'eccentrica signora americana, si trasferisce nell'appartamento accanto.

programme.title: A Royal Weekend
programme.desc: La storia della relazione d'amore tra il Presidente Roosevelt e sua cugina Margaret Stuckley che si consuma nel weekend del giugno 1939 quando il Re e la Regina d'Inghilterra fanno visita al Presidente presso il suo cottage di New York.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: Vita Da Camper
programme.desc: A causa di un'importantissima riunione di lavoro, Bob Munro convince moglie e figli a rinunciare alle vacanze alle Hawaii per un viaggio in camper verso le Montagne Rocciose, in Colorado. Una volta giunti a destinazione, i Munro devono vedersela con una bizzarra comunità di campeggiatori, tutti rigorosamente muniti di camper…

programme.title: La Squadra Più Scassata Della Lega
programme.desc: La nuova proprietaria dei Cleveland Indians forma una squadra orribile per poterla spostare.

programme.title: La Coniglietta Di Casa
programme.desc: Cacciata dalla Playboy Mansion e senza un posto dove andare, per volere del destino la coniglietta Shelley Darlington arriva alla confraternita femminile Zeta Alpha Zeta, uno sciocco gruppo di ragazze che rischia di perdere la casa - a meno che non impari quello che Shelley può insegnare loro.

programme.title: Vita Da Camper
programme.desc: A causa di un'importantissima riunione di lavoro, Bob Munro convince moglie e figli a rinunciare alle vacanze alle Hawaii per un viaggio in camper verso le Montagne Rocciose, in Colorado. Una volta giunti a destinazione, i Munro devono vedersela con una bizzarra comunità di campeggiatori, tutti rigorosamente muniti di camper…

programme.title: Travolto dagli affetti familiari
programme.desc: Un uomo cerca di bilanciare un matrimonio d'interesse con l'affetto per nonna e cane

programme.title: Pane, burro e marmellata
programme.desc: Bruno, lasciato dalla moglie, trova rifugio da tre donne e diventa il sultano del loro piccolo harem

programme.title: I due crociati
programme.desc: Ciccio e Franco, disastri tra Crociati e Saraceni, rovesciano per caso le sorti dello scontro finale.

programme.title: Scusi ma lei le paga le tasse
programme.desc: Un funzionario cade in disgrazia per colpa del nipote, che poi gli soffia la promozione.

programme.title: Il medico dei pazzi
programme.desc: Dalla commedia di Eduardo Scarpetta. Totò è il generoso zio di uno scapestrato nipote, che l'ha ingannato dicendo di essersi laureato e di dirigere una clinica psichiatrica (in realtà la clinica non esiste, è solo un mezzo per spillar quattrini). Totò un giorno arriva a Napoli per controllare la vita del nipotastro. Capita nella pensione di questi e prende i pensionanti per matti.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Provetta d'amore
programme.desc: Tommy e Audrey sono pronti ad avere un bambino. Tuttavia, dopo mesi di continui tentativi andati a vuoto, a malincuore, capiscono di essere semplicemente sfortunati.

programme.title: A Little White Lie
programme.desc: Un tuttofare vive e lavora a New York City dove viene scambiato per uno scrittore famoso e viene portato in un'università. Qui dovrà tenere il discorso di apertura per salvare il festival letterario dell'istituto.

programme.title: Koza Nostra
programme.desc: Vlada, premurosa signora ucraina, diventa nonna e decide di trasferirsi in Sicilia per conoscere il nipotino ma la figlia la mette alla porta. Vlada si ritroverà nell'improbabile ruolo di governante di Don Fredo, capo di una disfunzionale famiglia mafiosa.

programme.title: Ciao Brother
programme.desc: Il film narra le avventure di Angelo (Pablo), quarantenne scombinato, simpatico ma un po' farabutto.

programme.title: Mamma mi sono persa il fratellino!
programme.desc: Quando i genitori partono per la Francia lasciandola col terribile fratellino, Kathy lo trasforma in un porcellino usando le pietre magiche della tata. La ragazza, però, finisce per pentirsene e fa di tutto per riuscire spezzare l'incantesimo.

programme.title: I complessi
programme.desc: Quirino cerca di conquistare Gabriella, amante di Alvaro, con la complessità della timidezza.

programme.title: Il clan dei due Borsalini
programme.desc: Ciccio e Franco alle prese con un "colpo" ai danni di una gioielleria. I due maldestri ladri verranno acciuffati e finiranno in prigione.

programme.title: Lillo e Greg: The Movie
programme.desc: Una collezione antologica delle migliori scenette comiche firmate da Lillo e Greg, in compagnia di tanti famosi colleghi. Un concentrato di ironia e musica dai tratti surreali e farseschi.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Spedito nella fattoria di bestiame del nonno, situata nella remota regione di Pilbara, nell'Australia occidentale, l'undicenne Mick si prepara a una vita di noiosi stenti. Non si aspetta un cane che cambierà per sempre il corso della sua esistenza.

programme.title: Il Figlio di Cleopatra
programme.desc: Tra congiure imperiali e battaglie spettacolari, il figlio di Cleopatra lotta per riconquistare il proprio destino e difendere l'Egitto. Diretta da Ferdinando Baldi

programme.title: Nel Segno di Roma
programme.desc: Con Anita Ekberg e diretto anche dal grande Michelangelo Antonioni.Nell'antica Roma, guerre, alleanze e passioni si intrecciano mentre un impero lotta per imporre il proprio destino.

programme.title: Solo contro Roma
programme.desc: Il console romano, dopo aver conquistato la città di Alesia, lascia a governare un suo Tribuno. Perfido e crudele, quest'ultimo commette a ogni tipo di nefandezze, arrivando a far arrestare il capo della città e sua figlia, Fabiola. Quando Brenno, il fidanzato di Fabiola viene condannato a morte, la città di Alesia si ribella.

programme.title: Giulio Cesare conquistatore delle Gallie
programme.desc: Giulio Cesare guida l'esercito romano nella battaglia contro i ribelli in Gallia.

programme.title: I predoni della città
programme.desc: Uno sceriffo cerca di fermare i conflitti tra contadini nel West dopo la guerra civile.

programme.title: Custer eroe del West
programme.desc: L'amore di George Armstrong Custer per le tradizioni eroiche del Calvario e il suo disgusto per l'avvento dell'industrializzazione lo portano al suo destino al Little Big Horn.

programme.title: Killer, adios
programme.desc: Un giovane torna nella sua città natale dieci anni dopo aver ucciso l'assassino dei suoi genitori. Una volta lì, gli viene chiesto di aiutare lo sceriffo.

programme.title: Bianco Apache
programme.desc: Un neonato sopravvissuto a un massacro viene adottato dagli indiani e cresce come fratello del figlio del capo. Un tragico incidente lo condanna all'esilio. In città subisce un'ingiustizia crudele, ma sopravvive e torna per affrontare il suo passato e il destino dell'“Apache bianco”.

programme.title: L'ombra di Zorro
programme.desc: I fratelli Billy e Dan vanno in California per uccidere Zorro e vendicare la morte del loro fratello.

programme.title: Lo credevano uno stinco di santo
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fuorilegge sono in cerca del tesoro nascosto di un vecchio prigioniero: solo uno lo troverà

programme.title: L'uomo della valle maledetta
programme.desc: Gwen sposa Torito e lo segue. Rapita da una tribù rivale, fugge grazie a un cowboy.

programme.title: I tre del Colorado
programme.desc: Per contrastare i soprusi degli inglesi, la popolazione locale cattura la figlia di un industriale.

programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.
